title: Jaked Jihadists
author: Mohammed N.
desc:
Getting Jacked Using Home Equipment,  Rings, Barbells , DBs , and A Simple Pulley
No Fancy Machines? No Problem (Note:Jihad Means Struggling in Arabic)

ss.note: Use A Wide Grip (Outside Shoulder Width)
At Least Go To Parallel If you have the shoulder mobility, Go ATG

ex.note: This Is For Warming up the Elbows Before French Press

ss.note: Please Keep these Straight Legged and Go as Deep as Your Mobility allows you (Touch and Go)
Each "Set" Includes Doing a Set for Each Leg
Each "Set" includes doing a Set for Each Leg
Only Add Weight if You're Strong Enough in This Rep range
Only Add Weight if You're Strong Enough,  And Use a Decline For Upper Chest
Make Sure To Use a Height That Suits Your Strength
Use A Wider Grip and Use Straps, Once You Can't Get any More Concentric Reps, Do Kelso Shrugs
Use a Progession that Suits Your Strength in this rep range
First 2 Sets Use a "Heavy" Progression and Last 2 Sets Use a "Lighter" Progression
The Last Set Is a "Down Set" Use a Less Amount of Weight And "Try" to Get High Reps
Use Rings If You Dont Have access/You Don't Like The Cable Version
Paused For 1-2 Seconds
Use A Wide Grip (Outside Shoulder Width)
At Least Go To Parallel If you have the shoulder mobility, Go ATG
